determinism.purpose: stabilize font subsetting and PDF bytes across identical renders

execution_envelope.parent_environment: allowlisted rendering environment; isolated Python startup
execution_envelope.protocol_storage: three inherited anonymous regular file descriptors

known_issues: Do not downgrade below 70.0; 70.0 includes a security fix.
PDF/A and PDF/UA conformance are not asserted by RPT-08 and remain RPT-12 work.
Current environment warns that HarfBuzz-Subset will be required by a future WeasyPrint version; version 70.0 remains functional without it.
Deterministic rendering pins SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 inside each isolated render worker.
The bounded subprocess is a resource envelope, not an OS network/filesystem sandbox or a complete-operation aggregate memory guarantee.
The parent-death signal covers the renderer process, not arbitrary forked descendants; OS sandbox and aggregate process budgets remain unestablished.
The 30-second renderer budget excludes parent-side input preparation, native interpreter startup, queueing and PDF postvalidation.
Resource fixture measurements in resource_budget describe the earlier activation fixture, not a new benchmark of this worker.

process_local_sandbox.supported_environment: Linux x86_64; Landlock ABI 4 or newer
process_local_sandbox.scope: native PDF renderer and fixed PDF metadata/structure/accessibility workers only
known_issues: UDP and non-TCP networking are not restricted by Landlock ABI 4.
Previously opened file descriptors remain usable.
No cgroup or namespace isolation is established.
Standalone validators and other PDF workers are out of scope.
process_local_sandbox.disable_path: existing PDF renderer/validation disable environments fail closed

network_syscall_guard.source_of_syscall_map: linux x86_64 asm/unistd_64.h; fixed syscall numbers
known_issues: The seccomp syscall denylist does not block all network use via inherited descriptors or direct write(2).
This profile does not isolate process namespaces, UDP operations on inherited sockets, arbitrary descendants or aggregate resource use.
A different kernel architecture or inability to load the filter fails closed; there is no unsafe opt-out.
